selection_findings.claim: MESH_1D or device960 uses cost-table selection; all other known shapes/non960 use ExecuteSelector.
AIV AllReduce legacy helper: MESH_1D and ranks<=8 uses strict dataSize<128KiB OneShot; otherwise TwoShot. Ranks>8 uses <512KiB.
AICPU AllReduce single-level mesh legacy helper uses <=8MiB OneShot, after special dtype/PROD and two-rank detour conditions. Generic large selection uses ratio=8/rank/rank, not (8/rank)^2.
TWO_DIE_REGULAR requires MESH_1D, more than two ranks, both endpoint-die link counts nonzero and counts differing by one. Product generation alone is insufficient.
A5+ with supported HcclConfigGetInfo obtains expansion mode from communicator config; older/no-config paths use environment overrides.
AllReduce count is full per-rank data; AllGather count is per-rank send; ReduceScatter count is per-rank receive. Variable collectives need their count vectors.
Cost-table evaluation groups transfer/reduce/copy and launch terms, then selects minimum cost after eligibility/priorities/config/tuner. It is not a fixed message-size switch.
